text.title: Business Model Research Procedure
text.summary: Step-by-step procedure to apply the Business Model Research methodology end-to-end. Each step lists input, action, output, and an optional decision gate. Folds in the former agentic-pipeline file: Eight-step workflow, subagents, prompt patterns for build and validate passes, SDD integration, and agent gotchas. Prompt patterns are in `content/05-examples.xml`, gotchas in `content/03-failure-modes.xml`.

step.name: value-chain-map
step.action: Agent diagrams Suppliers - Product - Customers with cost arrows.
step.decision-gate: If chain is not signed off, STOP.

step.name: revenue-shortlist
step.action: Score 5 archetypes against the chain; pick 2 with one-line reasons for the 3 rejections.

step.name: comparable-harvesting
step.action: WebSearch 3-5 public competitors per archetype; pull pricing pages + 10-K when listed; tag URLs and retrieval dates.

step.name: canvas-fill
step.action: Populate 9 blocks; tag every cell H/S; cite source URL on H cells.
step.decision-gate: Refuse to proceed if any block is empty.

step.name: unit-economics-p-bands
step.action: Compute CAC, LTV (<=60mo), LTV:CAC, payback in P10/P50/P90.

step.name: stress-test-and-verdict
step.action: Run all 5 stress tests at P50; check P10 LTV:CAC >= 1:1; emit viable / viable-with-fixes / not-viable.
step.decision-gate: If verdict = not-viable, propose 2 alternative archetypes and re-loop step 2.

step.name: validation-pass
step.action: Peer agent re-reads the report against the assumptions ledger using the validate prompt in `content/05-examples.xml`.

section.title: Pipeline at a glance
section.p: The same procedure as the eight-step agentic pipeline it was generated from; step 7 above is item 8 here, items 7 and 8 map onto steps 6 and 7.

list.item: 1. Value chain map: agent diagrams Suppliers -> Product -> Customers with cost arrows; founder confirms before any price is named
2. Revenue-model shortlist: pick 2 of 5 archetypes that fit the value chain; reject others on record
3. Comparable harvesting: WebSearch 3-5 public competitors per shortlisted model; pull pricing pages, S-1/10-K if listed
4. Canvas fill: populate all 9 blocks; mark each cell Hard/Soft
5. Unit economics block: compute CAC, LTV, LTV:CAC, payback in P10/P50/P90
6. Stress test: run 5 tests; model passes only if it survives all five at P50
7. Verdict: one of {viable, viable-with-fixes, not-viable}; if not-viable, propose 2 alternative models and re-loop step 2
8. Validation pass: peer agent re-reads against assumptions ledger and returns delta list
Output lives at .aidocs/product_docs/business-model.md; assumptions ledger at .aidocs/product_docs/business-model-assumptions.csv
Reads SOM from market-research.md as the revenue ceiling; refuses to publish if year-3 forecast > SOM
roadmap.md MRR/ARR targets must reference a Canvas version; bumps require a new model run and a delta entry
spec.md lists revenue-affecting requirements traced to a Canvas cell (Key Activities or Revenue Streams)

text.reference: Shell script for P10/P50/P90 scenarios. P10/P50/P90 LTV:CAC and payback from four command-line arguments.
